Saudi Arabia is facing a major escalation in its conflict with Yemen’s Houthi rebels. Missile and drone attacks have targeted Riyadh, Dammam and facilities linked to oil giant Aramco. Civilians have been killed, including foreign nationals, with Indians among the dead and injured. As attacks spread, several countries are urging their citizens to take precautions or leave. India is coordinating with Saudi authorities to ensure the safety of its nationals, including pilgrims.
